details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3353-3361, 4103-4109 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Integration post-sync test repair" step and the conflict-resolver step now run a full `review_untrusted_sandbox.sh prepare codex`, but neither env block sets `DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS`. The broker is started with `"${DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS:-}"` (scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:160), so it falls back to `DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS` (scripts/dependency_registry_proxy.py:45-47). Only lines 3606 and 4423 in this workflow forward the variable.
  WHY: In consumer repos that set `vars.DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS` for a private index, the venv install is refused and the venv lacks the project's dependencies. Reviewers disagree on the effect: suites come back unverified/inherited so the repair turn never runs (sonnet, luna, glm), or import failures are reported as PR-caused and start a spurious repair turn (minimax). Severity is MAJOR from minimax and NIT from sonnet, luna and glm; the highest is used. Proposed fix: add `DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS: ${{ vars.DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS || '' }}` to both env blocks.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:712-780 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The integration gate runs `review_untrusted_sandbox.sh prepare codex` (lines 722-728) to build the dependency venv, but its environment does not include `DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS`.
  WHY: The proxy blocks `pip install` from a private index, so the venv lacks the test dependencies, pytest suites fail or are classified unverified, and the repair turn is skipped. The source stated no severity, so low is a placeholder. This is the same root cause as the review_autofix.yml finding above, but it cites a different file, so it is not merged.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1030-1032 (mirrored scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:744-746) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The venv is built at `/source/.review-venv` in the deps container but mounted at `/opt/codex-venv` in the gate container (scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh). Its console scripts (`ruff`, etc.) carry the absolute shebang `#!/source/.review-venv/bin/python`, which does not exist in the gate container, and they shadow the image's working global ruff on PATH.
  WHY: Reviewers describe the effect differently. minimax and glm: the by-name ruff static check fails with a bad interpreter or OSError, gets `{"status": "error"}` (prepush_affected_tests.py:629-630), and becomes `unverified` (line 740-741), so lint coverage is lost silently. gemini: the console scripts fail, so static checks and tests fail with "file not found". Severity is MAJOR from minimax and glm; gemini stated none. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly disputed this as not reproducing: it says `bin/python3` is a symlink to the base interpreter in the same image and ruff's wheel installs a native binary.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:719-746 (also scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh `_resolver_prepush_test_gate` `gate_venv_args` block) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: A full prepare can exit 0 without building a venv: the deps container exits 0 when the proxy bridge is unavailable (scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:203-204), and installs are skipped when the broker socket never appears (line 317). In that case the gate silently runs without `--venv` and logs no warning.
  WHY: Every pytest suite is reported `pytest_unavailable` (prepush_affected_tests.py:571-572), so the status is `unverified` and never `fail`, the repair turn never runs, and nothing in the logs points to the cause. Severity is NIT from sonnet; gemini stated none.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:773-774 (also scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh resolver gate, line 1120) | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `review_untrusted_sandbox.sh cleanup` call is skipped if the preceding prepare or the gate run is interrupted by a SIGKILL (for example a job timeout).
  WHY: On long-lived runners, repeated timeouts pile up snapshot-sized directories under `RUNNER_TEMP` until the disk fills. The source stated no severity, so low is a placeholder. This is related to the minimax SIGKILL finding below, but the line ranges differ, so it is not merged.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:731-741 (also scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1017-1026) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The sandbox root is learned only from `REVIEW_SANDBOX_ROOT=`, which is written at the end of a successful prepare (scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:324). The prepare's EXIT trap (line 77) never runs under a `timeout --kill-after` SIGKILL, so `root`/`gate_root` stays empty and the caller's cleanup (`if [ -n "${root}" ]` at review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:784-786) is skipped.
  WHY: Every killed prepare leaves a snapshot-sized `${RUNNER_TEMP}/review-isolated-*` directory on the runner, and nothing in the log records the leak. Severity is NIT.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:325-330 (scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:206-210) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The review gate passes the prepared Python venv but not the prepared Node dependencies (`--node-modules`), and the wrapper's snapshot excludes `node_modules`.
  WHY: For JS/TS tests, `npx --no-install` cannot resolve the tools installed during `prepare codex`, so those tests fail or are classified as inherited instead of being verified. Severity is MAJOR. minimax raised the same point as a hardening suggestion only.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1017-1021 (also scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:731-733) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The image-only `prepare-ephemeral` was replaced by a full `prepare codex`. That runs PR-controlled install/build-backend code in a deps container that is not `--read-only` and has registry egress through the proxy. This is weaker than the gate's declared isolation contract (docs/plans/prepush-affected-test-gate-plan.md:231-234), and the deviation is not recorded.
  WHY: No secret is exposed (the container gets `env -i` and no credentials, and egress is limited to vetted registries). However, the effective isolation is weaker than declared and undocumented, and it extends an existing accepted pattern. Severity is NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 noted the same pattern but judged it not a new capability gap.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Integration (P3-P5). Each step script runs end to end with a fake `docker` ... and a fake editor, covering pass, PR-caused fail → one repair, inherited-only, timeout → UNVERIFIED, mode `off`, module absent." (docs/plans/prepush-affected-test-gate-plan.md:762-765). Also, gates are documented to get their image and dependency venv from one full `prepare codex` with a `prepare-ephemeral` fallback.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_conflict_resolve_sandbox_only.py (`_run_resolver_gate_fixture` fake `review_untrusted_sandbox.sh`; `test_resolver_gate_repair_contract`) and tests/test_review_prepush_test_gate.py (integration-mode case for `review_prepush_test_gate_integration_main`)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The resolver fixture's fake sandbox handles only `prepare-ephemeral` (tests/test_review_conflict_resolve_sandbox_only.py:1191), so every run silently takes the fallback. The contract test asserts only `"prepare-ephemeral codex" in body` and `"cleanup" in body`. tests/test_review_prepush_test_gate.py has no integration-mode case. No test exercises the `prepare codex` path (scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1017-1021), the `--venv` setup (:1030-1032), the private `GITHUB_ENV` root parsing, or the rewritten integration path (scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:725-786). Severities: MAJOR (minimax), NIT (sonnet, gemini, luna).
- requirement: "P4 and P5 together may add at most 3,000 bytes to it [review_autofix.yml]" and "`review_autofix.yml` byte growth asserted against the `fc91d577` baseline + 3,000" (docs/plans/prepush-affected-test-gate-plan.md:225,759-761, 802-803)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py (workflow-size assertion at line 10839) and .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The only size check is the absolute cap `assert WORKFLOW.stat().st_size < 430_000, WORKFLOW.stat().st_size` (tests/test_review_autofix_review_pipeline_contract.py:10839), and `fc91d577` appears in no test. agents.d/8210-prepush-gate-integration-repair.md:32 discloses growth of 3,468 bytes, which is over the 3,000-byte budget. Severity is NIT from all three. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this as a disclosed overage far below the 480,000-byte guard.
- requirement: The integration gate for `orchestrator/project-*` branches should forward `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_MODE` (default `repair`) to the conflict resolver and the heal editor.
  expected_change_site: scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh and scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh was not updated to pass `PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_MODE` to the editor turn or the conflict resolver, and the variable was not added to the env of the `review_conflict_resolve.sh` calls in integration mode. Severity is BLOCKER. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash call this a documented deferral (changelog.d/8201, agents.d/8201 "Mode reach"). glm adds that in integration mode the resolver inherits it from the step env (review_autofix.yml:3357).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:about 3353-3361, about 4106-4109 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The "Integration post-sync test repair" and conflict-resolver env blocks do not set `DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS`; it is set only at lines 3606 and 4423. The new full `prepare codex` in `review_prepush_test_gate_integration_main` and `_resolver_prepush_test_gate` therefore starts the broker with `"${DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS:-}"` (scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:160) and falls back to the default hosts. `INTEGRATION_TEST_REPAIR_ACTIVE=true` also skips the normal install step.
  WHY: Private-index installs are refused and the venv lacks dependencies. Suites fail on head and baseline (classed as inherited) or come back `unverified`, so the repair turns never run. Proposed fix: add `DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS: ${{ vars.DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS || '' }}` to both env blocks.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh and scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:`venv_args` / `gate_venv_args` blocks | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A full prepare can exit 0 without building a venv (scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:203-204; line 317). `root` is still valid, so no `prepare_failed fallback=image_only` warning is logged and the gate runs without `--venv`.
  WHY: Every pytest suite becomes `pytest_unavailable` (prepush_affected_tests.py:571-572) and the status is `unverified`, so the repair never runs and no warning is logged. Proposed fix: an `else` branch that logs `outcome=warning reason=venv_absent`.
